lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The first thing Noah did on dry land was not rebuild a house. It was build an altar.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He took one of every clean animal and offered it as a burnt offering.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Never again will I curse the ground because of humans. Never again will I destroy all life.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: I have set my rainbow in the clouds. It is the sign of the covenant between me and the earth.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Colour tore across the sky — red, gold, green, blue — a promise written in light.

lines.speaker: family
lines.text: All eight of them stood in the mud and stared at the sky. Nobody spoke.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The story looked like it was over. It was not over.
